then.text: Saw's gone to the band? Good. It was wasted on me.

else.text: A saw for the band? Here. It's the one my grandad scraped his screwdriver on. It's got a good ring.
Salt ponds are filled by the sea and baked by the sun. We rake the crust into heaps, shovel it into barrows and send it all over the world.
A day on the ponds is a sunburn you can taste.

tci_bermudian.text: Bermudians were the main salt rakers on the Turks for generations. They came each season, raked the salt and sailed home. Eventually many stayed.
If you want evidence, look at the houses. The limestone, the stepped roofs. A bit of Bermuda, a long way south.
